text: Chapter 8: Road to Eldenbaum@The Former God of Justice
Go to the ruins on Mt. Mithurna to see Obligaus\nthe former God of Justice!
Obligaus seems to be at the top of the mountain.\nStay alert and keep going!
Fight Zelbuse the guardian of Obligaus to go to the ruins\nof the gods!
[[N]]Go to Ruins of Mt. Mithurna: Summit.
